purpose: Ask Q18-S1's uniform question at the fully commuting grouping endpoint, which Q18 and Q18-S1 excluded from cost, before any finite-shot second-moment estimator is built.
claim_boundary: This config declares a post-hoc Q18-S4 successor to Q18-S1 and carries no execution result. It prices the ground Ritz root's residual norm against its energy under single-assignment fully commuting settings with uniform shots, on the four 8-qubit licensed banks, with Q18-S1's estimator, statistic and tenfold bar. FULL or RESTRICTED licenses building that estimator on the affordable banks, subject to a separately preregistered sampled validation. No verdict makes a sampled, device-time, correlated-reference or quantum-advantage claim. NONE closes the fully commuting uniform estimator on these four banks.
question: On each of the four 8-qubit licensed banks, does estimating the ground Ritz root's residual norm sigma from shared word means under single-assignment fully commuting settings, to the same standard error as its energy measured the same way, cost at most ten times the energy's shots?

estimand.root: the ground root of the retained block's (S, H) pencil, solved by the package's default thresholds, normalized c'Sc = 1
estimand.variance: sigma^2 = c'Kc - E^2, with K the SecondMomentBank block A_i^dagger (H^2 A_j) paired with the reference. It equals ||(H - E)|Psi>||^2 / <Psi|Psi>, the squared residual norm PLAN.md section 4.4 names
estimand.residual_norm: sigma = sqrt(sigma^2), in the energy's own units: Weinstein's theorem puts an eigenvalue within sigma of E, so (E, sigma) is the measured pair a residual reports
estimand.estimator: every S, H and K entry is reconstructed from one set of shared word means; the measured pencil is solved and sigma^2 read from the measured K at the measured Ritz vector. Nothing is re-measured per entry
estimand.shift: Measuring (H - c)^2 instead of H^2 changes nothing here. Its rows are combinations of the same S, H and K rows, so with shared word means the reconstruction is algebraically the same function of the same means, and so is its linearization. The gate's tests check this to rounding on the Hubbard dimer

linearization.energy: the existing ritz_functional: the word expansion of B'(H - E)B with B = sum c_i A_i. The energy is stationary in c, so no Ritz-vector term enters
linearization.residual: the word expansion of G = B'(H - E)^2 B - sigma^2 B'B - [V'(H - E)B + B'(H - E)V], with V = sum v_i A_i and v = sum_{k>0} c_k (c_k'(K - QS)c) / (E_k - E), Q = c'Kc. sigma^2 is not stationary in c, so the last term, the Ritz vector's own movement, is required: on the Hubbard dimer it is 3.7% of the weights
linearization.implementation: residual_functional in benchmarks/check_phase15_measured_residual_preregistration.py, which the producer imports rather than restates
linearization.properties: G has zero reference expectation, and its weights are invariant under a constant shift of H; both are deterministic checks

direction_definitions.functional: the residual functional's own non-identity weights, normalized to unit length: the derivative along it is ||g||_2
direction_definitions.sh_gaussian: a seeded standard normal draw over the non-identity (S, H) words, normalized: those words carry the Ritz-vector term

finite_difference.rounding_floor: RESOLUTION * cancellation_scale / step, with RESOLUTION = 1e-12 from clifford_qc.subspace.second_moment and the cancellation scale the validation record's
finite_difference.rule: |central difference of the nonlinear pipeline - g . d| <= relative_tolerance * ||g||_2 + rounding_floor, for both directions
finite_difference.calibration: On the undeclared Hubbard dimer the step leaves the truncation error near 5e-9 of ||g||_2, with and without a -75 Ha constant added to H to reproduce H2O's cancellation scale. A dropped Ritz-vector term fails it by orders of magnitude

derivative_validation.rule: Evaluate all four central differences. Richardson R(h)=(4 D(h/2)-D(h))/3. Both final pairs must match the analytic derivative within relative_tolerance*||g|| + propagated RESOLUTION*cancellation_scale/h; they must also agree within the relative term plus both propagated floors. Every endpoint retains full rank and the declared nondegenerate ground root. No step is selected based on its discrepancy.

grouping.energy_universe: the measured (S, H) universe: the raw U_SH, the (S, H) bank's words over the retained block, minus the identity, listed in ascending code order exactly as the mapping-axis producer lists its JW arm
grouping.residual_universe: the measured combined universe: the raw U = U_SH | U_K minus the identity. The raw U is every word a measured second-moment bank's rows carry, and the H-squared preflight record committed its size and SHA-256
grouping.universe_convention: Raw universes include the identity, as the Phase 2M-A ledger, the H-squared preflight record and the mapping-axis record count and hash them; every frozen basis starts with I, so S_00 carries it. Measured universes are the raw ones minus the identity, whose mean is 1 and is never measured. Every count and digest in measured_before_freezing whose name starts with raw_ is a raw quantity; measured_sh_words and measured_combined_words are one fewer, and every grouping partitions a measured universe
grouping.variance: per setting, Var_psi(sum_{w in g} f_w P_w) on the exact reference, by run_mapping_axis._functional_variance, the function behind the committed mapping-axis energy variances. V is their sum: the estimator's variance at one shot per setting

protocol_definitions.fc_greedy: clifford_qc.measurement.block_commuting.block_commuting_partition(n, codes, n) on the measured universe listed in ascending code order. One block spans the register, so a setting is any pairwise commuting set. Words are placed largest conflict degree first, ties by code, into the first setting they commute with.
protocol_definitions.fc_isotropic_cover: clifford_qc.measurement.regrouping.isotropic_cover(n, codes, n) on the same list. Each setting grows as an isotropic subspace: every generator is the compatible word that brings the most unassigned words into its span, and the setting takes every unassigned word the span contains.

grouping.rationale: Two constructions of one fully commuting rule, as Q18 declared two QWC ones, so that no status rests on one heuristic. Both are deterministic functions of the word set, and neither claims a minimum setting count. The greedy is the package's shipped colouring; the cover is the regrouping module's strongest construction at block size n.
grouping.measurement: A fully commuting setting is read through a Clifford diagonalizer, so each one-shot outcome is an eigenvalue of sum_{w in g} f_w P_w, and its variance is Var_psi of that sum: the formula Q18 applies to a QWC setting. The diagonalizing circuits carry two-qubit gates, and they are not priced.
grouping.statevector_check: Every setting variance from run_mapping_axis._functional_variance, an operator square, must equal <O^2> - <O>^2 from matrix-free action on the reference statevector within 1e-9 of max(1, <O^2>, <O>^2).

statistic.name: R
statistic.derivation: Uniform shots make a linearized estimator's variance V / N at N shots per setting, so a standard error s costs G * V / s^2 shots. sigma is read from sigma^2 through d sigma = d sigma^2 / (2 sigma). Matching the two standard errors at s, the s^2 cancels: R is the residual's shots over the energy's at any one matched precision, to first order
statistic.rationale: A decade is the unit this repository reads as material, as in Q16's word clause and Phase 16B's 10x modelled-shot rule. A residual within a decade of its energy's shots is a by-product of measuring that energy well; beyond it, it is a measurement of its own. A ratio exactly at ten is affordable
statistic.matched_precision: Matching the standard errors of E and sigma makes both ends of the measured Weinstein interval [E - sigma, E + sigma] carry the two sources equally
statistic.linear_regime: d sigma = d sigma^2 / (2 sigma) holds while the standard error of sigma^2 is small against sigma^2. At a matched precision s that error is 2 sigma s, so the record reports matched_precision_half = sigma / 4, the s at which it reaches one half of sigma^2. Finer precisions are where R describes the cost; coarser ones do not resolve sigma from zero. No clause reads it
statistic.diagnostics: the record also reports the Neyman ratio, both sides at variance-optimal allocation across settings, (sum_g sqrt v_g)^2 in place of G * V. No clause reads it

bank_status_order.condition: R <= 10 under the declared protocol, and under the alternative where one is declared
R > 10 under the declared protocol, and under the alternative where one is declared
the declared and alternative protocols put R on opposite sides of 10

decision_rule.invalid_precedence: A failed deterministic check makes that bank INVALID, and any INVALID bank makes the verdict INVALID.
decision_rule.combination_rule: every bank AFFORDABLE gives FULL; no bank AFFORDABLE gives NONE; anything else is RESTRICTED; any INVALID bank gives INVALID

consequences.FULL: Post-hoc, under single-assignment fully commuting settings only. Phase 15 builds the finite-shot second-moment estimator on the four banks with fully commuting settings: S, H and K sampled from shared word means, and sigma with a delta-method interval labelled asymptotic, cross-checked by the grouped bootstrap. Its sampled validation is a new preregistration that freezes seeds, budgets and coverage targets. This licenses building the estimator, not any sampled claim, and covers the banks' determinant references only.
consequences.RESTRICTED: Post-hoc, under single-assignment fully commuting settings only. The estimator is built and validated only on the AFFORDABLE banks, which become its scope by name, under the same separately preregistered sampled validation. Residuals elsewhere stay exact or matrix-free, and extending the estimator needs a new declaration.
consequences.NONE: Post-hoc fully commuting closure: no finite-shot second-moment estimator under uniform single-assignment fully commuting settings on these four banks. With Q18-S1's NONE, the uniform single-assignment estimator closes negative at both grouping endpoints the package ships, on these banks. Exact residuals, convergence reports and folded roots remain available.
consequences.INVALID: No verdict. The record names the failed check, and no status is read from the run.

banks.basis: Each bank at its frozen selected_labels, through the same _build_model and _selected_generators Q18 and Q18-S1 use.

excluded.h2o_cas8e6o: Both fully commuting partitioners build a W x W conflict-mask table. At H2O's 868,149 measured words that is about 7.5e11 pairs, and the package ships no scalable fully commuting cover. Building one would be a new heuristic, not this question. H2O's Q18-S1 reading under QWC, R = 1,579, stands.

banks.not_declared: Every bank outside the five, including the 14-qubit molecular banks, which the H-squared preflight left to the Phase 2M storage gate or a preflight of their own.

deterministic_checks: baseline_matches_freeze: every measured_before_freezing value recomputes at execution, and every premise flag in it holds
combined_universe_matches_preflight: the raw U, rebuilt from SecondMomentBank rows, has the committed size and SHA-256 and contains the identity
energy_settings_reproduce_freeze: both protocols' (S, H) partitions have the frozen setting counts
functionals_reproduce_q18s1: both functionals' word counts equal Q18-S1's record, and their norms, sigma^2 and the ground energy agree with it within 1e-9 relative
partitions_valid: each partition assigns every word of its measured universe to exactly one setting, and every setting is pairwise commuting
residual_functional_reproduces_variance: sigma^2 at the exact means equals the validation record's within 1e-9 (1 + kappa)
linearization_matches_finite_differences: Q18-S1's Richardson rule passes on both directions
group_variances_nonnegative: no setting variance is below -1e-10 of its scale
group_variances_match_statevector: every setting variance agrees with matrix-free statevector action within 1e-9 of max(1, <O^2>, <O>^2)
provenance: the record carries clean provenance from a declared environment

evidence.label: asymptotic
evidence.statement: First-order (delta-method) variances at large shot counts, computed exactly from each bank's determinant reference and frozen basis. No sampling, no seed beyond Q18-S1's finite-difference direction, no finite-sample claim.

excluded_from_cost: the Clifford diagonalizers fully commuting settings need: their two-qubit gates, depth and fidelity, and so device time
variance-optimal allocation, reported only as the Neyman diagnostic
multiple assignment and span reading: a fully commuting setting can read its group's GF(2) span, but every word is assigned once
the plug-in bias of sigma^2 and any second-order effect
correlated references: every bank's reference is a determinant, a stabilizer state, on which a fully commuting setting's variance can collapse; a prepared correlated state would change both sides
H2O CAS(8e,6o), and every bank outside the five
exploratory_disclosure: Seen before this declaration: every Q18 and Q18-S1 record value, including their QWC ratios (H4 567 and 563, converged H4 1,311 and 1,322, BeH2 184,358 under both, H2O 1,579, Hubbard 2x2 21.0 and 17.2) and Q18-S1's oracle allocation diagnostics; the Q18-S2 and Q18-S3 records; and Phase 14b's fully commuting energy-side result on BeH2, whose covariance-aware variance was 2.22 times lower at matched shots. Before freezing, the declared banks saw first moments only: each (S, H) solve and both fully commuting partitions of each (S, H) universe, which give fc_energy_settings. No second-moment row, residual functional, combined-universe partition or setting variance was formed on a declared bank. The fully commuting pricing was developed on the undeclared Hubbard dimer, where the two protocols put R on opposite sides of ten (0.0019 under the greedy, 37 under the cover) and every setting variance matched a dense statevector computation to 1e-14. Both partitioners were timed on random 8-qubit word sets of 2,047, 8,191 and 13,939 words, at most 3.1 s each.

prespecified_followup.statement: The estimand, linearization, protocols, threshold and banks are fixed. Another threshold, protocol, allocation, reference or bank set would be a new declaration. The consequence each verdict names is what follows.

successor.disclosure: Q18-S1's NONE closes the uniform QWC estimator on the five banks. This successor changes only the partition, to the fully commuting endpoint Q18 and Q18-S1 excluded from cost, and drops H2O, where no fully commuting partition is feasible. Every predecessor ratio was seen, so the design is post hoc; commit order protects execution identity only.

implementation_lineage.note: Inputs stay bound for the life of the record. The rows, the bank, the functionals, the derivative validator, both partitioners, the setting variance, the statevector action, this gate, the producer and the checker stay bound until the record names its own clean execution commit.
